scripts.db:create: cd backend && uv run python scripts/db_admin.py create
scripts.db:upgrade: cd backend && uv run alembic -c alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:init: cd backend && uv run python scripts/db_admin.py init && uv run alembic -c alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && uv run python scripts/db_admin.py seed
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run python main.py
scripts.dev:worker: cd worker && uv run python -m app.main
scripts.check:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check --fix app
scripts.check:worker: cd worker && uv run ruff check --fix app
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check app
scripts.lint:worker: cd worker && uv run ruff check app
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:backend && pnpm lint:worker && pnpm lint:frontend
